description_en: Retrieves a list of data lake functions
description_zh: 调用此API可获取数据湖函数列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-lake-function --tid 30000 --catalog-name hive --db-name default --function-name-pattern .0 --next-token f056501ada120000 --max-results 20 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakeFunction

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

> Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: A regular expression used to filter the returned function names
parameters.help_zh: 函数名匹配的正则表达式，用于过滤返回的函数名称
parameters.name: function_name_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

- If **NextToken** is empty, there is no subsequent query.

- If **NextToken** has a value, it is the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: max_results
